description: Jet 4 MDB: session 1 creates P(ID PK), C1(ID PK, PID), C2(ID PK, PID) with R_Upd (UpdateCascade=256) and R_Del (DeleteCascade=4096) and closes; session 2 deletes R_Upd (keep pages at-return + 1500ms), then deletes R_Del (keep pages at-return + 1500ms), then closes. Read-only reopen checks Relations and P/C1/C2 Indexes.
